email_draft.subject: Escalation: Critical Exceptions in Processing Invoice INVO002 from DairyBest Pvt Ltd
email_draft.body:
Dear AP Manager,

The processing pipeline for invoice INVO002 (dated 2026-04-02, vendor: DairyBest Pvt Ltd, PO: P01002, total: INR 19845.0) has encountered critical exceptions requiring manual review and intervention. Key issues include:

- Critical: GROK screening failed due to a parsing error (LLM_SCREENING_UNAVAILABLE).
- Warning: PO number discrepancy ('P01002' vs. master 'PO1002'), possible OCR error.
- Critical: Over-receipt for item 'Mozzarella Cheese (Grated)' (GRN 20.2 > PO 20).
- Info: Quantity variance for the same item (invoice 20 < GRN 20.2).

Matching was performed assuming PO1002 due to similarities, but 3-way match failed for one item. Screening stage failed critically, yet downstream agents proceeded with available data.

Please review the attached exceptions panel and take necessary actions, such as verifying OCR accuracy, adjusting GRN/PO quantities, or approving variances.

Best regards,
AP Operations Bot

For item 'Mozzarella Cheese (Grated)', invoice quantity 20 is less than GRN quantity 20.2.
